title: Session list with CRUD, rename, delete, resume, modes, root
description: Implement session list UI: list all sessions (GET /session) with title, message count, mod time, backend tag. Actions: resume (attach to session), rename (PATCH), delete (DELETE with confirm), create new. Show session config (model, mode, root) on resume. Folder picker (native dialog) to set session root. Mode selector (coding/conversational/reviewer/architect/tester).
acceptance_criteria: Session list: shows title, message count, mod time, backend tag
Resume: click session to attach, chat transcript loads
Rename: PATCH /session/{id} with new title, list updates
Delete: DELETE /session/{id} with confirm dialog, list updates
Create new: button creates new session, attaches to it
Session config: model, mode, root displayed on resume
Folder picker: native dialog to set session root
